$comment: Known incompatibilities of published packages that the 0.18 train fixes (eng/train/README.md, 'Expected failures'). An entry applies only while the named package is below the given version, so it can never hide a failure of the train's own candidates. Remove each entry in the release that fixes it.

entries.title: Runic.Translations.CommandLine 0.9.x requires Runic.CommandLine [0.9.1, 0.10.0), so it does not restore with Command Line 0.10 or later (NU1608)
entries.remove: In runic-sdk's 0.18.0 release PR, after Runic.Translations 0.10.0 is published.

entries.title: Runic.Translations.CommandLine 0.9.x has no German message for hints.usage, so German output keeps one English line
entries.remove: In runic-sdk's 0.18.0 release PR, after Runic.Translations 0.10.0 is published.

failures.match: ^English framework text in German output: Run "
^English framework text in German output: Run "

entries.title: Translations 0.9.x ranges: Hosting and Wpf accept any Runic.Translations >= 0.9.1, and the adapter's Command Line bound is 0.10.0 instead of the -0.0 form
entries.remove: In runic-sdk's 0.18.0 release PR, after Runic.Translations 0.10.0 is published.

entries.title: dotnet-runic-translations 0.9.x prints its version as 0.2 (a constant in tools/dotnet-runic-translations/Program.cs, also written into SARIF reports)
entries.remove: In runic-sdk's 0.18.0 release PR, after Runic.Translations 0.10.0 is published with the package version as the tool version.

entries.title: The Translations editor 0.9.x pins CsWebUi 2.5.0-beta.4.8 exactly; runic-sdk 0.17's Views.CsWebUi needs beta.4.9 or later (NU1605, or NU1109 under the editor's central package management). S8 is informational; the entry only names the cause.
entries.remove: In runic-sdk's 0.18.0 release PR, after Runic.Translations 0.10.0 is published.
